missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бог' is the nominative subject of 'видит' and 'знает'. 'Всё' is the accusative object of both verbs. A common proverbial statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'в'. 'Бог' is animate masculine, so its accusative 'Бога' matches the genitive form. 'Верить в' takes the accusative to express belief in someone.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Богу' is the dative form because 'молиться' governs the dative of the addressee. 'Каждый вечер' is an accusative time phrase.

missions.phrase: У них нет веры в Бога.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative inside a prepositional phrase. 'Бога' is the animate accusative after 'в'. 'Нет веры' uses the genitive 'веры' under negation, while the belief object stays accusative.

missions.phrase: Я говорю с Богом в молитве.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Богом' is the instrumental form expressing the partner of conversation. 'В молитве' is a prepositional phrase of manner.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'о'. 'Боге' is the prepositional form for the topic of discussion. 'Детям' is the dative recipient of 'рассказывают'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Боги' is the nominative plural subject of 'жили'. 'Древние' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'на горе' is a prepositional place phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. 'Богам' is the dative plural because 'поклоняться' governs the dative. 'Многим' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Бога' is the genitive form showing whose temple it is. 'Древнего' is the agreeing masculine genitive adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative in a fixed expression. 'Богу' is dative in the set phrase 'слава Богу' meaning thank goodness. The clause 'всё закончилось хорошо' explains the relief.
